definitions.closure: a seed is inside the (twin-class) closure of G if its argmax concept map, read through the twin classes, equals cls o pi for some pi in G.
definitions.haar_test: exact randomisation test of the mean (level) concept accuracy of the included seeds: each included seed independently draws one value uniformly from the accuracies of its own confusion relabelled by every element of the condition's group; 20,000 Monte Carlo means give a two-sided p-value and the central 99% interval. Vacuous when the group is trivial; not testable with fewer than 3 included seeds.
definitions.included: at the label optimum AND inside the closure of the condition's group (a G-invariant event).
definitions.label_optimum: program optimum = the highest label accuracy reached by any random-head, shared-network seed of the program in this run; a seed is at the label optimum if its label accuracy >= optimum - 0.02.
definitions.level: digit level for twin-free programs; twin-class level (concepts compared through their twin classes) for programs with twins, the only level the labels can identify.
definitions.seed_class: trap classification by loss, per seed of a random-head shared-network condition: 'optimum' if at the label optimum; 'trapped' if not, and its excess loss (test label NLL minus the median NLL of the program's optimal seeds) is within 10% of a Theorem B level (m/n)^2 log 2 of the program (frustrated_pairs, computed before training) and positive; otherwise 'unclassified' (reported, never dropped).
definitions.seeds: conditions of the v2 pilot keep seeds seed0, seed0 + 1, ...; v2.1 conditions (plain-NeSy arm, E6, E7) use their own hashed seed blocks, so no two of them share initialisations.

instrument_checks.I1_pooled_PIT: pooled randomised PIT of every seed within its exact relabelling distribution; |G| > 1, excluding E5 and seeds with tie rate > 0.5 (tie-decided PITs). KS p >= 0.01.
instrument_checks.I2_pooled_z: pooled z of (acc - Haar mean) on the same seeds; |z| <= 2.58.
instrument_checks.I3_E5_spread: E5: median orbit spread < 0.01. This checks that the GPU arithmetic preserves exact ties.
instrument_checks.I4_haar_consistency: every condition with |G| > 1 (except E5): Haar test of its included seeds inside the central 99% interval. Expected count outside if all code is right: 0.01 per condition.
instrument_checks.I5_explanation_floor: uniform rho_data, twin-free programs, shared network, >= 2 included seeds: the orbit-averaged read-out's log-loss is within 0.5 bits of the floor sum_g P(g) log2|G.g| (the floor for equivariant read-outs), and the naive read-out is above the floor.
instrument_checks.I6_tied_heads: E5: label accuracy <= U_tie + 0.02 (corrected sandwich: orbit-mode <= tied-head ceiling <= U_tie; tied heads on the G-orbits, zero heads on the coarsest equitable partition); a zero head on a program whose one-cell partition is equitable (head_dead) stays within 0.02 of chance.

primary_family.P1_achievability: E1 nesy, pooled over programs WITHOUT Theorem-B frustrated pairs: fraction of included seeds (twin-class level). H0 (theory): rate >= 0.8; one-sided exact binomial; the theory FAILS if H0 is rejected.
primary_family.P2_trap_contrast: E1 nesy: seeds NOT at the label optimum, programs with >= 1 Theorem-B pair vs programs without; one-sided Fisher exact test (more with pairs). The theory PASSES if the contrast is significant. (Counted on seeds off the label optimum, not on 'trapped', because 'trapped' is defined by the Theorem-B levels and would be 0 by construction without pairs.)
primary_family.P3_trap_level: E1 nesy, programs with Theorem-B pairs, seeds off the label optimum (selected by label accuracy, not by loss, so the test is not circular): excess loss / nearest Theorem-B level, TOST of the mean against [0.9, 1.1] at 5%. PASSES if equivalence is shown; fewer than 3 such seeds: 'not testable' (not a pass).
primary_family.P4_anchors: E3 nesy: Haar test under the pointwise stabiliser of the anchors, twin-class level; FAILS if rejected. Vacuous (not counted) when the stabiliser is trivial.
primary_family.P5_multitask: E7 nesy: Haar test under the intersection group; FAILS if rejected; vacuous if trivial.
primary_family.P6_prior: E4 nesy (skewed data prior, no prior matching): post-hoc frequency gauge-fixing from m unlabeled images; pooled error count vs the Bhattacharyya bound + 0.05, one-sided exact binomial per m, Bonferroni over m; FAILS if rejected.
primary_family.P7_support: E6 (restricted support): mean concept accuracy vs the Burnside level of the support group G_S (an exact upper bound for an equivariant learner); one-sided t-test, FAILS if the mean is significantly above it. The identification capacity Lambda(E) of the observational equivalence set is reported next to it.
primary_family.expected_failures: If the theory is exactly true, P(any FAIL among P1, P4-P7) <= 0.05 (Holm). P2 and P3 are confirmatory: their pass rate is a power, not computable from the theory.

secondary_method_arm: Re-grounding (gfrg) conditions: achievability per E1 condition, anchors (E3), multi-task (E7), prior matching (E4 acc >= 0.9). Reported separately; not evidence for the theory.
study: What the knowledge can define: symmetry laws for concept grounding in NeSy learning (v2.1)
